You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which models in the catalogue, self-certified today with internal checks, will need a notified body from 20 January 2027?

Facts:
[0] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall inform the notified body (shall inform the notified body) [DIR, Annex X]
[1] CE marking — hasObligation — must be followed by the identification number of the notified body (must be followed by the identification number of the notified body) [condition: Where the full quality assurance procedure referred to in Article 12(3)(c) and 12(4)(b) has been applied] [DIR, Annex III]
[2] notified bodies monitoring — verifiedBy — Member States (Member States) [DIR, Art. 14(2)]
[3] original EC declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[4] applicant — hasObligation — shall inform the notified body which retains the technical file (inform the notified body which retains the technical file of all modifications to the approved type) [DIR, Annex IX]
[5] notified body — hasObligation — any conformity assessment activities (any conformity assessment activities) [condition: on request] [REG, Art. 40(1)]
[6] periodic audits — verifiedBy — The notified body (the notified body) [DIR, Annex X]
[7] products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC — placingAllowedUntil — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [condition: placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 14 January 2027] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6]
[8] EC declaration of conformity — hasObligation — must contain the following particulars (must contain the following particulars) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[9] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[10] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: in any event] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[11] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product (for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[12] manufacturers — hasObligation — affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 24 (affix the ce marking in accordance with article 24) [condition: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[13] notified body — definedAs — conformity assessment body notified in accordance with this Regulation (conformity assessment body notified in accordance with this regulation) [REG, Art. 3(30)]
[14] manufacturers — hasObligation — draw up the EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21 (draw up the eu declaration of conformity in accordance with article 21) [condition: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[15] manufacturers — hasObligation — bears at least a designation (bears at least a designation of model, series or type) [condition: ""] [REG, Art. 10(5)]
[16] notified body identification number affixing — hasObligation — shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer (shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer) [condition: Where the conformity of machinery or a related product is assessed] [REG, Art. 24(3)]
[17] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 10(3)]
[18] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall lodge an application (lodge an application for eu type-examination with a single notified body) [REG, Annex VII, 3]
[19] copy of the EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 13(8)]
[20] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical file kept by notified body — retentionPeriod — for a period of five years (P5Y) [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[21] EC type-examination — definedAs — the procedure whereby a notified body ascertains and certifies (the procedure whereby a notified body ascertains and certifies) [DIR, Annex IX]
[22] Directive 2006/42/EC — repealedFrom — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5]
[23] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall immediately inform the competent national authorities (shall immediately inform the competent national authorities) [condition: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Art. 11(9)]
[24] EC declaration of conformity — hasObligation — must be those of the texts published in the Official Journal of the European Union (must be those of the texts published in the Official Journal of the European Union) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[25] indicative list of safety components — listedIn — Annex II (annex II) [condition: in the light of technical progress and knowledge or new scientific evidence] [REG, Art. 7(2)]
[26] manufacturer — hasObligation — take appropriate corrective actions (take appropriate corrective actions) [condition: Where a notified body finds that the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, or corresponding harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Article 20 have not been met by a manufacturer] [REG, Art. 38(3)]
[27] manufacturer, declaration of conformity — hasObligation — issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer (issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer) [REG, Annex V, Part A, point 4]
[28] EC declaration of conformity — hasObligation — the place and date of the declaration (the place and date of the declaration) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[29] CE marking — definedAs — a marking by which the manufacturer indicates (a marking by which the manufacturer indicates) [REG, Art. 3(25)]
[30] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[31] manufacturers — hasObligation — Manufacturers shall ensure (manufacturers shall ensure that the machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[32] notified body — definedAs — Only such a body shall be considered a notified body (only such a body shall be considered a notified body) [condition: for the purposes of this Regulation] [REG, Art. 34(5)]
[33] technical documentation and EU declaration of incorporation — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 11(3)]
[34] notified body — hasObligation — shall inform the notifying authority (shall inform the notifying authority) [REG, Art. 40(1)]
[35] Chapter VI of this Regulation (mutatis mutandis to such products) — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [condition: mutatis mutandis to such products instead of Article 11 of that Directive, including products for which a procedure has already been initiated under Article 11 of Directive 2006/42/EC] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 7]
[36] manufacturers — hasObligation — immediately inform the competent national authorities (immediately inform the competent national authorities) [condition: where the machinery or related product presents a risk to the health or safety of persons] [REG, Art. 10(9)]
[37] relevant technical documentation for partly completed machinery — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex VII]
[38] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3) (specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(3)) [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[39] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall draw up the EU declaration of incorporation in accordance with Article 22 (shall draw up the eu declaration of incorporation in accordance with article 22) [condition: Where compliance of partly completed machinery with the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III has been demonstrated in the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B] [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[40] regular inspection of machinery or related product — verifiedBy — designated bodies (designated bodies) [condition: may be subject to national requirements for regular inspection] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.10]
[41] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall use the appropriate verification methods (shall use the appropriate verification methods) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.1]
[42] safety components — listedIn — Annex II (annex ii) [REG, Art. 7(1)]
[43] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — EU type-examination (module B) (eu type-examination (module b)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[44] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (ISO? no) [condition: In order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.4]
[45] 1.7.2 warning of residual risks — requiresMeasure — warnings, including warning devices (warnings, including warning devices) [condition: Where risks remain despite the inherent safe design measures, safeguarding and complementary protective measures adopted] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.2]
[46] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall specify the means used by the manufacturer (shall specify the means used by the manufacturer to ensure the conformity) [REG, Annex IV, Part B]
[47] indicative list of safety components — listedIn — Annex V (annex v) [DIR, Art. 8(1)]
[48] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A — requiresProcedure — specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) (specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(2)) [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[49] manufacturer — hasObligation — the internal measures that will be implemented (the internal measures that will be implemented to ensure that the partly completed machinery remains in conformity) [condition: for partly completed machinery produced in series] [REG, Annex IV, Part B]

response.text: {"kind":"set","value":["Machinery and related products in the categories listed in Annex I, Part B (EU type-examination, module B, Art. 25(3))"],"text":"Models whose category is listed in Annex I, Part B need EU type-examination (module B) under Art. 25(3) and Art. 6(1). The manufacturer applies to a single notified body (Annex VII, 3), so internal checks alone no longer suffice once Directive 2006/42/EC is repealed on 20 January 2027. Annex I, Part A categories also need the specific procedures of Art. 25(2), but the facts do not say what those procedures are. The facts also do not list the catalogue, so I cannot name individual models.","used":[22,38,43,48,18,21]}
